structured.answer: I didn't decide anything. As far as I understood, the page says the cheapest is the Yalin Lapidot S&P 500 fund through a Psagot account (70,000 ₪ becomes about 86,492 ₪ in 10 years, and the account takes about 1,057 ₪), and the big banks like Leumi or Mizrahi take thousands more. But it's American shares in dollars, not a deposit, so I'll ask my son before I do anything.
